budget_items.topic: Police vehicles (two, one marked and one unmarked), FY18 request
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Police Department's FY18 request for two vehicles, one marked and one unmarked, is priced at $111,000, with a related $17,000 figure printed beside priority #1 and noted as requested from last year.
Eight tasers are requested at $10,500; the chief said he is awaiting updated proposals that may come in lower.
budget_items.quote: tasers 8 $10,500 #2 explanation: awaiting for updated proposals, that may come in lower.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Riot gear to outfit 28 officers, added to the six tasers the department already has, is estimated at $20,000 with a seven-year estimated life.
budget_items.quote: added to the six tasers pd already has. to expand the service by having a total of 14 units.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A prospective elevator is listed under future items at #200,000, to more fully utilize the second floor; the chief does not expect it in FY18. (OCR jumbled this section.)
